name: drill_gate
purpose: Pre-gate a drill plan before staging: is every artifact reversible, and is staging scoped to the designated drill boxes only? Advisory — operator approval remains mandatory.
state_template: DRILL PLAN: <technique, target boxes, artifacts to stage, undo for each, what census/hunt should detect>. CONTEXT: <production boxes in the estate, anything the undo set cannot restore>.

reversible.instructions: Is every staged artifact in this drill fully reversible using the drill's undo set?

scoped.instructions: Is the staging scoped to the designated drill boxes only, with no production exposure?

gate.instructions: What should the drill pipeline do?

criteria.plan_first: Show the operator the drill plan before staging
criteria.refuse: Do not stage — wrong scope or not reversible
